chatgpt.name: ChatGPT
chatgpt.input_hint: The main large textarea or contenteditable at the bottom of the page, typically with placeholder text like 'Message ChatGPT' or 'Ask anything'. This is the primary chat input.
chatgpt.send_hint: The send or submit button immediately adjacent to the input area. It is often an arrow or paper-plane icon and may only enable after text is entered.
chatgpt.response_container_hint: The last assistant message block in the conversation. Use the most recent message that is not from the user.
chatgpt.completion_signals: Stop button disappears, copy or regenerate controls appear, and the input becomes active again.
chatgpt.notes: React-controlled input. Open a temporary chat to avoid stale conversation context. If send remains disabled after fill, click the input once, re-snapshot, and try again.

claude.name: Claude
claude.input_hint: A contenteditable chat input near the bottom of the page, often with placeholder text like 'How can Claude help you today?' or similar.
claude.send_hint: A small arrow or send button to the right of or below the input that becomes active after text is entered.
claude.response_container_hint: The last Claude assistant message in the conversation, not the user's message.
claude.completion_signals: Streaming cursor stops, action buttons such as Copy or Retry appear, and the input becomes active again.
claude.notes: Uses contenteditable elements. Always use /new for a fresh conversation.

gemini.name: Gemini
gemini.input_hint: The main input at the bottom, which may be a rich textarea or contenteditable editor, usually with placeholder text like 'Ask Gemini'.
gemini.send_hint: A circular send button with an arrow icon adjacent to the main input area.
gemini.response_container_hint: The latest non-user response block in the main conversation area.
gemini.completion_signals: Streaming stops, text stabilizes, and response action buttons appear below the answer.
gemini.notes: The UI changes frequently. If multiple inputs exist, choose the prominent bottom composer.

grok.name: Grok
grok.input_hint: A textarea or text input at the bottom of the chat interface with placeholder text about asking Grok a question.
grok.send_hint: A nearby submit button with an arrow or send icon.
grok.response_container_hint: The most recent assistant or bot message block in the conversation.
grok.completion_signals: Response text stops growing, the input becomes active again, and action buttons appear.
grok.notes: Requires an active X or Twitter session in the managed browser.
